role: Get-Me-Back breadcrumb model (BreadcrumbFix, BreadcrumbTrail) and the file-backed store for the one active trail (active.json) plus a newest-first archive of up to 50 trails (archive.json) in the App Group 'Breadcrumbs' directory.
types: BreadcrumbFix: struct — one Codable GPS fix (time, lat/lon, h-accuracy, optional altitude/course/speed)
BreadcrumbTrail: struct — Codable trail: startedAt, origin fix, ordered fixes, optional label, resolved origin label and isWorkoutTrack
BreadcrumbStore: final class @unchecked Sendable — serial-queue JSON persistence of active trail and archive
state: static archiveRetentionLimit = 50 (BreadcrumbStore.swift:159; workout tracks evicted first by capped)
toplevel: BreadcrumbFix/BreadcrumbTrail use synthesized Codable/Equatable; files are JSON with iso8601 dates and sortedKeys. `static let shared` is created lazily on first access via the private init. Header comments (lines 127-140) describe active vs archive vs auto-imported workout trails (WorkoutRecorder+Context.swift:475 calls archive).

flags.text: No test in EmuquTests references BreadcrumbStore, BreadcrumbTrail or BreadcrumbFix: persistence, migration, the corrupt-archive refusal and the 50-trail cap are unverified.

units.does: Builds a BreadcrumbFix from a CLLocation: copies timestamp, lat/lon, horizontalAccuracy; altitude only when verticalAccuracy >= 0, course only when >= 0, speed only when >= 0, else nil.
Returns CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude, longitude) of the fix.
Rebuilds a CLLocation from the fix for distance math: altitude ?? 0, verticalAccuracy 5 when altitude present else -1, course ?? -1, speed ?? -1, original horizontal accuracy and timestamp.

branches.effect: true: verticalAccuracy -1 (invalid); false: fabricated verticalAccuracy 5 m

units.does: Straight-line distance in meters from the last fix to the origin fix; nil when origin or any fix is missing.

branches.effect: false: return nil; true: last.asCLLocation.distance(from: origin)

units.does: Sums CLLocation distances between consecutive fixes (path length); 0 with fewer than 2 fixes.

branches.effect: accumulate distance from fixes[i-1] to fixes[i]

units.does: Singleton init: resolves the Breadcrumbs storage directory, creates it (errors logged by attempt), sets active.json/archive.json URLs, and moves a legacy trail.json into active.json if needed.
units.entry: static let shared lazy initialization (first access to BreadcrumbStore.shared via LocationServices.breadcrumbStore)

units.does: Returns <AppGroup container>/Breadcrumbs, else <Documents>/Breadcrumbs, else <tmp>/Breadcrumbs.

branches.effect: true: Documents/Breadcrumbs; false: temporaryDirectory/Breadcrumbs (purgeable by the OS, so a trail would not survive)

units.does: One-shot migration: if Breadcrumbs/trail.json exists and active.json does not, moves trail.json to active.json (failure logged via attempt and ignored).

branches.cond: legacy trail.json exists AND active.json does not exist
branches.effect: true: move legacy to active; false: nothing (legacy file left in place if active.json already exists)

units.does: Test-seam init: uses fileURL as active file and archive.json in the same directory; creates the parent directory. No legacy migration.

flags.text: init(fileURL:) has no caller anywhere in the repo, including EmuquTests (grep "BreadcrumbStore(fileURL" finds nothing); the "tests written against v1" it was kept for do not exist.

units.does: Synchronously (on the serial queue, so after pending saves) reads active.json via contentsIfPresent and decodes a BreadcrumbTrail with iso8601 dates; nil when the file is missing, present but unreadable (logged by contentsIfPresent) or fails to decode (logged).

branches.effect: log error, nil (callers read it as no trail)

units.does: Returns a file's bytes; nil without a log when it does not exist, nil with an error log when it exists but cannot be read (before first unlock, I/O error).

Asynchronously on the serial queue encodes the trail (iso8601, sortedKeys), recreates the Breadcrumbs directory if missing, and atomically writes active.json with completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication protection; encode/write errors are logged by attempt and dropped.

branches.effect: false: return without writing (logged); true: ensure dir and write

units.does: Moves the active trail into the archive: load() it, then on the serial queue appendToArchive and, only when that wrote the archive, remove active.json; when the archive could not be read or written the active trail is kept (error logged).

branches.effect: false: return (nothing archived, active.json untouched even if present-but-corrupt); true: queue the archive
log, keep active.json; else remove it

flags.text: When the archive write fails the active trail stays on disk, but BreadcrumbRecorder.endAndArchive has already dropped it from memory, so it reappears only at the next launch (and, if its last fix is under 12 h old, the recorder resumes recording it).

units.does: Asynchronously deletes active.json on the serial queue; a missing file error is logged by attempt and ignored.
Synchronously (after queued writes) reports whether active.json exists, without decoding it.
Synchronously (after queued writes and erases) reports whether archive.json exists, readable or not.
units.entry: Called by DataPurgeService.readBackClearedStores to verify the breadcrumb erase.

units.does: Synchronously (on the serial queue) returns decodeArchive's trails (newest first), or [] when decodeArchive returns nil (present but unreadable or undecodable, both logged).

branches.effect: [] (the failure was logged; AI facts report no trails)

units.does: Reads the archive for a write: [] when the file does not exist, nil when it exists but cannot be read (logged by contentsIfPresent) or decoded (logged), else the decoded trails.

branches.effect: logs error and returns nil so caller refuses to overwrite

units.does: Asynchronously (on the serial queue) appends a trail to the archive via appendToArchive, ignoring its result.

flags.text: Every finished outdoor workout auto-archives its track (WorkoutRecorder+Context.swift:475) into the same 50-slot list as manually engaged Get Me Back trails, so an active user loses their manual trails to workout tracks after 50 workouts.

units.does: On the serial queue: reads the archive with decodeArchive, prepends the trail, trims with capped (50, workout tracks evicted first), encodes (iso8601, sortedKeys) and atomically writes it with completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication. Returns true only when the write succeeded; false (archive untouched) when the existing archive is present but unreadable, or encoding or the write failed.
Trims a newest-first trail list to archiveRetentionLimit (50) by repeatedly removing the oldest trail with isWorkoutTrack == true, or the oldest trail of any kind when none is a workout track.

branches.effect: remove one (oldest workout track ?? oldest) and repeat

units.does: Recreates the parent directory of url if it no longer exists (after Delete All My Data).
Asynchronously deletes archive.json; does not touch active.json. Called by DataPurgeService.
